crossRefs.note: Who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?

crossRefs.note: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
crossRefs.keyword: answer thee. Heb. return to thee words. thy

translations.web: I will answer you, and your companions with you.
translations.bsb: I will reply to you and to your friends as well.
translations.kjv: I will answer thee, and thy companions
translations.asv: I will answer thee, And thy companions with thee.
